title: Write-ahead for landing onto the base branch
summary: decide() persists the approved consequential_repository_write gate and a final.landing 'intended' marker before calling _land; step() calls _recover_landing, which finishes an intended landing whose outcome was not saved by re-running _land (an expected-value fast-forward, a no-op if already landed), then finishes the run and records landing.recovered. Evidence: before 3 violations in 40 seeds; after 0 in 80 seeds across two ranges (32 kill-points, 7 landings, 3 rejected landings with main unchanged) plus a regression test; EVR-0015 routing noninferior (78/78). Checkpoint commits (commit only when dirty) and cleanup (git branch -d refuses unmerged branches) were reviewed and are naturally idempotent/safe, so no change there.

prior_art.found: write-ahead intent logging before external effects; idempotent effect completion on replay
prior_art.why_custom: fits the existing run record and git fast-forward semantics; no dependency
